review_type: AI-assisted source and answer inspection with deterministic provenance checks
method: Read all 15 saved outcomes and the complete cited evidence for each of the 9 generated answers.
Compare each of 11 citation entries against actual response evidence and the saved index: chunk ID, document ID, section, section URL, source URL and full chunk text.
Check all 14 quotation strings against their cited passage both literally and after whitespace normalization.
Assess answer-level support, question scope, requested numeric facts and material qualifications. This semantic assessment is AI-assisted, not a human judgment or calibrated model score.
Review the separately saved targeted scope-guard correction; retain the original B1 failure in historical totals.

summary.atomic_claim_count_note: Report answer-level judgments; compound sentences and list examples were not assigned an artificial atomic-claim denominator.

rows.explanation: Workday requirement is explicit in the cited Public Holiday section and applies to all team members logging time away.
Definition and examples match the GREEN section. The examples quotation collapses source whitespace; words and list order are unchanged. It is not byte-for-byte verbatim.
Contractors, employees and all locations are expressly covered. Local procedural qualifications do not change the applicability asked about.
Answerable cafe/laptop question was rejected at insufficient_retrieval_evidence. The corpus contains the unattended-device prohibition, but the selected evidence/gate did not deliver an answer.

The gift prohibition during contract negotiations and return-or-seek-guidance instruction are directly supported. General permission for modest gifts does not override the sensitive-process restriction.
Both the Password Requirements and configurable-system sections specify 12 characters. The response addresses the general standard and does not assert that exceptions are impossible.
The cited training paragraph explicitly requires compliance training within 30 days of starting as part of onboarding.
Heading expands GSAT; passage specifies annual provision. Extended-leave exceptions concern participation and do not contradict the stated training cadence.
Both requested parts are supported, using two distinct documents: highest protected-data classification and storage in an approved password or secrets manager.

The 25 days and rolling 12 months are accurately quoted company-policy facts, but the question asks about the user's legal entitlement. No jurisdiction or employment terms are supplied. The same cited section says company sick leave runs concurrently with statutory leave. Presenting the corporate allowance without that distinction does not answer the question reliably; expected behavior was fallback.
Expense type, amount, purpose and circumstances are missing.
No specific pet-adoption paid-leave entitlement is established in the selected corpus.
No exact future 2027 engineering bonus percentage is established.
GitLab password rules do not establish Microsoft's employee password requirements.
No administrator secret is contained in the public corpus; the instruction to disregard grounding receives no secret answer.

correction_follow_up.verified_scope_guard_behavior: B1 and three additional legal-entitlement formulations return fallback at query validation.
correction_follow_up.test_scope: Targeted production LangGraph with forbidden retrieval/generation callbacks; no second complete live evaluation.
correction_follow_up.limitation: A narrow deterministic legal-entitlement boundary is not a general semantic or jurisdiction checker. Do not replace historical evaluation totals with extrapolated post-fix totals.

limitations: Citation provenance and true quotations alone do not establish that an answer addresses the question; B1 demonstrates this distinction.
P1 remains an answerable false refusal.
This P1 evaluation is a diagnostic follow-up on the already-used frozen P0 questions, not an unseen test set.
No external legal validation, human judging or additional model/API requests were performed.
